reviews.title: I have zero complaints!
reviews.comment: Since EVGA has left the video card market, my opinion is XFX is the leading brand for customer support and quality of product.  I am using this card at 4k with a 5700x AMD cpu, and... 64 gigs of RAM (I'm not a millionaire, I bought it a couple years ago!).  I can't max out every setting on every game, but I adjust the settings as needed and I still have a fantastic visual gaming experience.  The difference between this and the comparable RTX 5070 ti  is small, but the $400+ extra dollars is not.
reviews.author: Daniel H.

reviews.title: strong card but AMD software can be frustrating at times
reviews.comment:
4 months with the card and still going strong. paired with a 9850X3D and i play mostly 1440p high frames/high quality/ but don't use ray tracing much personally.
ran resident evil requiem with ease, getting 180+ fps in Helldivers 2 (but that game needs a good processor as well).
AMD Adrenalin software can be a little janky sometimes, but the price/performance is hard to beat
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Solid buy, solid performance
reviews.comment:
I've always preferred AMD CPU builds along with an Nvidia card and MSI board. After 5 systems with Nvidia, I took the bait and switch over to an AMD card. It took a day to wrap my head around the Adrenaline Software and MSI Bios pairing, and I have to say< I'm extremely pleased with the build and this card. Along with a 9700x, MSI B850M -a PZ board, and 32Gb DDR5, this card slaps! The in-game quality is solid, the 16Gb is perfect, and the overall performance can only get better with overclocking. Stock, this scored a 98.7 in 3Dmark's Steel Nomad stress test. highly recommend.
The fact I ordered this at 9pm and received it next day early PM is also a win.
reviews.author: NeoJin

reviews.title: RDNA4 is very impressive
reviews.comment:
Such an impressive performance from AMD. I play 3440x1440 ultra everything. Raytracing without an issue.
XFX specifically makes it very easy to solder on a EVC2SE for even more performance and let me tell you, after pumping an additional 65mV this card is performing on par with a stock RTX 5080 for less than half the cost. Absolutely thrilled!
reviews.author: Zachary Humphrey

reviews.title: Great Card, Plenty of better value alternatives in used market for the price your paying, atm.
reviews.comment:
Works very well, runs very cool while gaming (atleast when I'm playing Overwatch 2, Left4Dead 2, Planetbase, and Black Ops 1). I've personally have never experienced a crash on this GPU yet, (hopefully I never do), but as long as the latest GPU drivers are installed and Windows 11 or Linux updates as well, you shouldn't experience any crashes.
Highly Recommend this or the 9060XT for a great more budget alternative. I bought this on Prime Day so the price was around $750 instead the $900+ price range 9070XTs were typically hovering around at the time. There is better value and more bang-for-your-buck GPUs in used/secondhand marketplaces, in my opinion.
Very beautiful, High-quality design and feel as well. Perfect for low-profile, all-black stealth builds.
